$comment: THE COSIGN PIN — the signing tool .github/workflows/image-release.yml downloads to sign and verify every published Dédalo image. Exactness with an updater, the .bun-version rule: `bun run ci:cosign:pin` (scripts/ci_cosign_pin.ts) resolves the latest STABLE sigstore/cosign release and the sha256 of its cosign-linux-amd64 asset from that release's checksums file; the nightly `cosign_pin` job (`ci:cosign:pin --check`) reports a pin that is unset or behind into the ci-nightly issue. While the values are null the release workflow REFUSES to publish: an unsigned image is never published. They are never typed by hand and never guessed — run the updater (it needs the network) and review the diff.
